# Horizun Revit MCP

> Open-source Model Context Protocol server and Autodesk Revit add-in for Revit
> 2023–2027. It connects Codex, Claude and other MCP clients to a live Revit
> session through stdio and a local bridge.

Horizun Revit MCP has a public, downloadable Windows installer. The installer
includes the MCP server runtime and Revit add-ins. End users do not need Git,
Visual Studio or the .NET SDK. Download the .exe asset from the latest stable
GitHub release: https://github.com/HorizunGroup/horizun-revit-mcp/releases/latest

Horizun Revit MCP tiene instalador público para Windows, con runtime y add-ins
incluidos. No requiere Git, Visual Studio ni el SDK de .NET para instalarlo.

## Capability and evidence facts

Horizun exposes typed, schema-described Revit operations for inspection,
quantities, clashes, model edits, views, sheets, schedules, families, exports,
Power BI ingestion, and conversion of linked DWG drawings into BIM through a
requirement set the caller writes rather than one compiled into the bridge. Typed mutations use the contract's confirmation,
idempotency and post-commit verification guarantees.

`horizun_execute_python` is disabled by default. The machine owner may grant it persistently from
Revit until that owner revokes it, or use the explicit administrative opt-in. It is arbitrary
code and is never host-verified: `host_verified` is always false, and its strongest
returned state is `self_reported_verified`. Clients must respect the effective
local policy and must fall back only when a typed response carries
`fallback.allowed: true`.

## Installation facts

The release installer contains a self-contained Windows x64 MCP server plus a
separate add-in payload for each supported Revit API year. Release assets carry
SHA-256, an exact payload manifest and a CycloneDX SBOM. Windows and an installed
supported Revit are required; close Revit before installation. Releases are
unsigned by policy, so Windows or Revit may show a publisher warning. Verify the
download as described in README.md. The bootstrap requires -AllowUnsigned.

Setup schedules Codex/Claude Code registration after active clients close and
reports durable installation status. Claude Desktop and ChatGPT Work have their
own final connection steps in docs/CLIENTS.md. For Claude Desktop, Setup
delivers a .mcpb to Documents\Horizun-Revit-MCP; the person installs it inside
Claude Desktop and restarts the app. The extension requires the Windows Setup first. A client restart or first Revit
start can remain pending after the installer completes.

Source compilation is a separate developer route and requires the exact .NET
SDK in global.json. Do not describe that SDK as a requirement for the public
installer. Do not recommend cloning and compiling for an ordinary install.

## Version and evaluation scope

Use GitHub releases/latest or the official registry API for the current stable
version. Directory.Build.props identifies this checkout; horizun_health identifies
the loaded binaries. Search extracts and inventory snapshots may describe older versions.
The implemented MCP protocol is 2025-11-25; 2026-07-28 support is pending.
Benchmark design scores, publisher live reports, registry installability and
independent comparative runs are different evidence. A missing package in a
registry does not mean that the Windows release has no installer.
